text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship hears a voice trying to guide 
her in a dream. No time to sit around! 
Gold Ship dashed out in search of Eden.

Advocating her own unique equation that 
Eden = the Realm of the Gods, Gold Ship 
found her path forward blocked by Super 
Creek.

Gold Ship unleashes a barrage of 
techniques presumably honed day and night 
to achieve godhood, yet Super Creek treats 
her like a baby. Her maternal instincts 
are too strong!

Mothers are mightier than the gods 
themselves. Faced with overwhelming 
motherly aura, Gold Ship suffers utter 
defeat... To be continued!
